about.heroLead:
GLS (Global Logistics Solutions) is a Saudi Arabia-based logistics provider delivering comprehensive freight solutions across the Kingdom and international markets.

From customs clearance and product compliance to final delivery, our objective is simple: to make global shipping efficient, transparent, and cost-effective with a single point of coordination.
about.companyP1: Global Logistics Solutions started as a boutique forwarder in Dubai and grew by staying close to clients on complex lanes. Today we combine air, ocean and project cargo desks with in-house customs teams at key hubs.
about.companyP2: We invest in people and process, not hype, so your team always knows who owns the next milestone on a shipment.
about.val1Desc: Transparent pricing, honest timelines and documentation you can audit.
about.val2Desc: We embed with your operations team, not just your inbox.
about.val3Desc: Measured by on-time performance and first-time customs clearance.
about.videoP1: From booking to final delivery, our coordinators handle documents, customs and carriers so you do not have to.
about.videoP2: Watch a short tour of our operations, from the port to the warehouse floor.

navigating-red-sea-reroutes.excerpt: How shippers are balancing transit time and cost when ocean lanes shift.
navigating-red-sea-reroutes.author: Global Logistics Solutions Operations
navigating-red-sea-reroutes.body:
Ocean carriers continue to adjust schedules across the Suez corridor. Global Logistics Solutions monitors sailings daily and advises clients on alternate hubs and air-sea combinations when deadlines are tight.

Key steps: confirm booking cut-offs early, allow buffer at transshipment ports, and align customs documentation before cargo arrives.

heavy-lift-planning-checklist.author: Project Cargo Desk
heavy-lift-planning-checklist.body:
Start with accurate weights and dimensions, lifting points, and route surveys. Share GA drawings and any permit restrictions for origin and destination.

Our project desk coordinates engineering reviews, specialized equipment, and port handling windows.
